newsitem.title: USA: United Tech says Pratt won counterclaims.
newsitem.headline: United Tech says Pratt won counterclaims.

text.p: United Technologies Corp Tuesday said a state court jury in San Antonio, Texas, found in favor of its Pratt & Whitney unit in a claim filed by Sequa Corp's Chromalloy Gas Turbine Corp.
United Technologies' statement was issued after Sequa said the jury found Pratt violated the Texas anti-trust act.

United Technologies said the jury also found for Pratt & Whitney on all its counterclaims against Chromalloy for alleged unfair competition, misappropriation of Pratt & Whitney data and drawings and fraudulent concealment of these facts.
United Technolgies noted that Chromalloy's claims for monetary damages and other relief were rejected by the jury.
